C or U: B1 [ C or U ] the act of politely or officially asking for something

NONE: B1 to ask for something politely or officially
（禮貌、正式的）要求，請求

C: › [ C ] a song or something similar that someone has asked to be included in a show or on the radio

example: They received hundreds of requests for more information.
數以百計的人要求他們提供更多的資訊。
[ + to infinitive ] The boss refused our request to leave work early.
老闆拒絕了我們早下班的請求。
The clause was added to the contract at Carlos's request (= because Carlos asked for this).
這一條款是在卡洛斯的要求下添加到合同中的。
An application form will be sent to you on request (= if you ask).
申請表格承索即寄。
The next song is a request from/for Roz in Oxford.
下面這首歌是牛津的羅茲點播的／為托特裡奇的羅茲點播的。
[ + that ] We requested that the next meeting be held on a Friday.
我們要求下次會議星期五舉行。
[ + obj + to infinitive ] Visitors are requested not to walk on the grass.
要求遊客們不要踐踏草地。
I requested a taxi for eight o'clock.
我要了一輛計程車，八點過來。

NONE: › a bus stop at which buses stop only if someone waiting there signals to them to do so
招呼站（一種公車站，只有等車的人示意停車，公車才會停下來）
› a mass (= a Christian ceremony) at which people honour and pray for a dead person
（基督教）追思彌撒，安魂彌撒
› a piece of music written for this ceremony
安魂曲

example: a requiem mass
一場追思彌撒
Mozart's/Verdi's Requiem
莫札特／威爾第的安魂曲

NONE: B1 to need something or make something necessary
需要；有賴於；要求；規定

example: Please call this number if you require any further information.
如需更多資訊請撥此電話號碼垂詢。
Skiing at 80 miles per hour requires total concentration.
以每小時80英里的速度滑雪需要全神貫注。
[ + obj + to infinitive ] Bringing up children often requires you to put their needs first.
撫養孩子常要把他們的需要放在首位。
You are required by law to stop your car after an accident.
法律規定，發生事故後必須停車。
[ + that ] The rules require that you bring only one guest to the dinner.
按照規定，你只能帶一位客人出席晚宴。

NONE: B2 something that you must do, or something you need
需要；有賴於；要求；規定

example: A good degree is a minimum requirement for many jobs.
很多工作的最低要求是要有一個好的學位。
[ + that ] It is a legal requirement that you have insurance for your car.
為你的車輛上保險是法律要求的。
Students who fail to meet the requirements (of the course) will fail.
達不到（本門課程）要求的學生將不能及格。

NONE: › necessary or needed for a particular purpose
必要的；需要的；必不可少的
› an important necessary thing
必需品；必要條件

example: He lacked the requisite skills for the job.
他缺少從事這項工作所必需的技能。
The requisite number of countries have now ratified the convention.
批准這項條約的國家已經達到了規定的數目。
A good book is a requisite for long journeys.
一本好書是長途旅行必備之物。
Self-esteem, self-judgment and self-will are said to be the three requisites of independence.
自尊、自量和堅持自我據說是自立的三個必備條件。

NONE: › to officially request or take something
徵用
› the act of officially asking for or taking something
徵用

example: The army requisitioned all the cars and trucks they could find.
軍隊徵用了他們能夠找到的所有轎車和貨車。
The staff made a requisition for new chairs and desks.
職員提交了一份新桌椅需求單。

NONE: › to give or do something in return for something given to you or done for you
報答；回報；報復

example: Requited love is not enough to sustain a long-term relationship.
僅僅彼此相愛還不足以使戀情天長地久。
